title: Lake City Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Comparing Lake City Painting with Precision Paint Experts for a Lake City home? See what to ask about stucco cracks, humidity, and exterior prep in writing.
h1: Lake City Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Lake City homeowners often deal with stucco hairline cracks and long humid stretches. Use those two problems as the yardstick when you line up competing painting bids.

How should a painter prepare stucco before repainting?

sections.h2: Two names on a Lake City shortlist
body: Maybe you have Lake City Painting's name on a notepad next to ours; Precision Paint Experts covers Lake City and the surrounding Columbia County area too. We will not score the other outfit here. What follows are the questions that count on Columbia County houses, worded so any bidder can answer them.

Two conditions show up again and again on Lake City exteriors: stucco with fine hairline cracking, and walls that hold moisture through a long humid season. A good proposal addresses both directly instead of leaving them to chance.

sections.h2: Stucco cracks: patch, bridge, or ignore?
body: Hairline cracks in stucco are common and often cosmetic, but paint applied straight over them tends to split along the same lines. Ask each contractor whether cracks will be cleaned and filled, and what coating will go over the wall afterward. Why those lines open up in the first place is covered in our Lake City stucco crack explainer.

Where a wall keeps shifting a hair, we call for an elastomeric coating that flexes as the stucco moves instead of splitting on top of it. Bigger breaks get handled as stucco repair before painting, with each patched area and its method written out on your quote.

Paint over damp substrate is a common reason for blistering and peeling. If a wall section or fascia board seems off, the crew lead puts a meter on it at the walkthrough and snaps photos, so the plan rests on numbers instead of hunches.

Before any topcoat, the crew washes the walls, kills mildew, scrapes and sands loose spots, renews caulk joints, primes bare patches, and swaps out rotten fascia when it turns up. All of that appears on paper ahead of time, and anything beyond it needs your sign-off first.

Wood trim, fascia, and soffits get the same scrutiny as the stucco. Swollen or punky boards get documented, and any replacement is spelled out as a line item you approve up front. Our post on why humid walls shed paint covers why a wall that reads damp should dry out before primer goes on, and why waiting a day can save years of finish life.

sections.h2: What to look for on a Lake City exterior bid
body: On our own bids you will see Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore products named outright: elastomeric for stucco that moves, 100% acrylic for lap siding and trim boards. Columbia County exteriors are happiest painted between October and May, and summer jobs here begin at dawn with the crew checking dew point and storm radar. Whoever you hire, check that their paperwork covers these points:
bullets: The coating named for stucco versus wood trim, by product line.
How cracks will be treated before coating.
Whether moisture was checked, and where.
Number of coats on each surface.
Timing that avoids heavy dew and afternoon storms.

sections.h2: Get a written scope for your Lake City home
body: There is no charge for the visit, and your itemized proposal normally lands one business day after the crew lead leaves. Every Columbia County crew we send is our own, never a hired sub, and we carry state licensing, a bond, and full coverage. Our Lake City exterior painting jobs also come with up to 10 years of written workmanship warranty. Schedule a walkthrough and compare our scope line for line.

faqs.q: Do hairline stucco cracks need repair before painting?
faqs.a: At minimum they should be cleaned out and dealt with. Our answer on shifting stucco is an elastomeric topcoat that gives with the wall, and every repair shows up as its own line on the quote.

faqs.q: Is Lake City inside your service territory?
faqs.a: It is. We cover Columbia County, including Lake City and Fort White, as one of the five counties we serve.

faqs.q: Can you paint a stucco exterior in summer?
faqs.a: We can. July jobs simply begin very early, and someone on the crew watches the dew point and the afternoon storm cells building over the county. The cooler months from October to May are easier on both the stucco and the painters.
